name: Basic American Enterprises
what_we_do: Intended to be an incubator, a holding company, an investment fund and a master agent for several business ventures (owner, 2026-10-18). An incubator that develops start-ups and gives them the core services of an accelerator or incubator, plus distribution: the territories (50 key people, 3 regions) are the distribution, with lead generation and a national rep network for every portfolio company. Basic American Intelligence adds core technology (AI) accelerator features inside each start-up. The strategy now being formulated has two aims: raise capital for a planned fund ('smart money'), and establish territory reps and distributors for the products and services of the incubator's companies. 'Smart money invests in smart American businesses.'
